title: Compliance precision view
description: Ephemeral Insight ViewModel wrapping DetectionQualityService.calibrate_compliance output. Review precision for recorded automatic compliance check firings and attributed human dismissals, not evaluator calibration, compliance coverage or a compliance score. Core derives counts, precision and inclusive precision <= gate flags; this schema validates their shape and ranges, not count arithmetic. No mutations or persisted artifact are implied.

assessments.description: Number of distinct recorded assessment documents considered by the producer, deduplicated by digest. Not a coverage denominator.

check_id.description: Raw untrusted check identifier, preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

precision.description: Producer-derived (fired - dismissed) / fired; null means unmeasured because there were no firings, never perfect precision.

flagged.description: Producer-derived review flag: measured precision <= gate, inclusive. Does not demote or disable a check.
